# Does your job posting state a pay range?

> Paste a job posting and pick the states it could be filled from. Instantly see whether the text appears to state a pay range, and which of those states currently require one by law, with the effective date and size threshold cited. Free, runs entirely in your browser — not legal advice.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
